name: ParagraphFormat
description: Represents the paragraph formatting of a text range.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment for each paragraph in the specified paragraph format. Read/write.

properties.name: Bullet
properties.description: Returns a BulletFormat object that represents bullet formatting for the specified paragraph format. Read-only.

properties.name: LineRuleBefore
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing before the first line in each paragraph is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: LineRuleAfter
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing after the last line in each paragraph is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: LineRuleWithin
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing between base lines is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceBefore
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space before the first line in each paragraph of the specified text, in points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceAfter
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space after the last line in each paragraph of the specified text, in points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceWithin
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space between base lines in the specified text, in points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: BaseLineAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the base line alignment for the specified paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakControl
properties.description: Returns or sets the line break control option if you have an Asian language setting specified. Read/write.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Used only with Kanji characters. Read/write.

properties.name: HangingPunctuation
properties.description: Returns or sets the hanging punctuation option if you have an Asian language setting specified. Read/write.

properties.name: TextDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the text direction for the specified paragraph. Read/write.
